messages:
Priya Kapoor: Hey finance team — travel question. I'm attending TOKEN Summit in SG (May 12-15). I need an expedited visa fee ($290 USD) and the vendor only accepts prepayment. Can finance either charge it to the corp card or issue an advance? I can upload the invoice. Link: https://invoices.example.com/priya-visa-290.pdf

Alex Chen: We usually avoid cash advances. Options: 1) Finance can prepay vendor if manager approves + vendor invoice + bank details. 2) Request a short-term advance via the Finance portal and reconcile after trip. Which do you prefer? See: https://redwood.internal/finance/advances

Priya Kapoor: Prepay would be easiest (vendor blocks slot until paid). Kim, can you approve?

Kim Park: Approved for prepay. Priya, please confirm attendee name on invoice = Priya Kapoor and email me the invoice. cc: @Finance Ops

Finance Ops: Thanks — can you upload the invoice to the vendor-payments form (https://redwood.internal/finance/vendor-payments) and paste vendor banking details? We also need vendor tax info (W-9 or local equivalent). We'll generate a PO and schedule payment in 3 business days once we have docs. If vendor requires payment in SGD, let us know for FX conversion. :calendar:

Priya Kapoor: Uploaded invoice and vendor bank details here: https://internal-files/visa-invoice-17255.pdf. Invoice shows 'Priya Kapoor'. Vendor prefers USD wire.

Finance Ops: Got it. We'll raise PO. Please note you'll need to attach visa receipt + boarding pass when reconciling so we can close the advance. Timeline: payment scheduled 1725504820 (3 business days).

finance-bot: Payment scheduled — PO# PO-2026-487. ETA wire: 3/24. :white_check_mark:

Priya Kapoor: Awesome, thanks! Quick Q: when I submit expense, should I mark 'Advance: Visa' in the claim?

Alex Chen: Yes — choose 'Expense type: Travel Advance' and include PO# in notes. The system will auto-offset once expenses are approved. :thumbsup:

Priya Kapoor: Will do. Thanks everyone.
